data.narrative:
Jimmy Energy is a Series A nuclear energy company that has raised €80M to date. The valuation universe for frontier nuclear includes 3 public comparables (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private peers, with a top-tier private peer set including Fuse Energy, Oklo, X-Energy, Nano Nuclear Energy, and General Matter.

Standard peer-median methodology is not applicable here. The nuclear energy sector contains only 4 same-sector peers total, and filtering by stage alignment (Series A or adjacent) and valuation tier yields fewer than 3 datapoints—the minimum threshold for reliable triangulation. Applying an all-sector median would introduce substantial category error given the distinct capital intensity, regulatory pathway, and technology risk profiles in nuclear versus broader energy. Public comps exist but trade at stages and scales materially different from a Series A deployment-stage company.

This analysis cannot produce a credible valuation range without additional data. To support a defensible range, the analysis would require either: (1) expanded private comparable data with stage and valuation details from the peer set named above; (2) transaction multiples or recent funding round details from same-stage nuclear peers; or (3) alternative methods such as discounted cash flow with explicit regulatory and construction timeline assumptions. The €80M already raised provides a floor reference point but does not constitute a valuation absent terms and ownership dilution data. Further due diligence on peer fundraising and equity terms is necessary.
